guides.title: Server Migration
guides.source_title: FGF Wiki — Upcoming Server Migration: Wave 3 Timeline and Guidelines
guides.caveat: Migration windows, eligibility and destination quotas vary by event wave and server group. Re-check the current in-game migration event. The infographic's 25-day cooldown is not verified by this source.
claims: A player must not have an existing character on the target server to migrate there.
All Flagships must be docked or idle before server migration.
A player must leave their current Commerce Guild before registering for server migration.
Trader Princes and holders of other official titles must step down as required for migration; royal titles do not carry over.
A player must submit a migration application before migration day and actively confirm migration on the designated day.
Migration eligibility and destination slots vary by migration group, destination server strength, and the player's historical peak power.
After migration, the Home Port relocates to a random starting region, server and Arena rankings are cleared, and in-game mail is permanently deleted.
unverified: At least 25 days must have passed since the last successful migration.
